def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:

    # |x>|y> -> |x>|y xor x>  in the mathematical ordering

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:

    # CNOT_{x->y} = (I ⊗ H) CZ_{x,y} (I ⊗ H)

    qc.cz(x[0], y[0])
    qc.h(y[0])

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    x, y = QuantumRegister(1), QuantumRegister(1)
    qc = QuantumCircuit(x, y)
    # CNOT x -> y implemented via a swap-conjugated CNOT.
    # SWAP ∘ CNOT_{y→x} ∘ SWAP  =  CNOT_{x→y}
    qc.swap(x[0], y[0])
    qc.cx(y[0], x[0])
    qc.swap(x[0], y[0])
    return qc
